title: Comparing Children's Books to Brochures for Safe Sleep and Infant Reading Education During Prenatal Care
brief_summary: The aim of this randomized trial is to compare a specially designed children's book to brochures for safe sleep education via clinical providers at a third trimester prenatal obstetric visit. Mothers in the control group will receive a specially designed children's book regarding the importance of reading with their infant at this visit, compared to brochures. Knowledge of safe sleep and home literacy orientation will be assessed at baseline prenatally, and their first postpartum obstetric visit.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. confirmed viable pregnancy, with estimated gestational age (EGA) of at least 36 weeks at the baseline/enrollment prenatal visit,
2. maternal age at least 16 years old,
3. comfort speaking English during their visit and reviewing/comprehending study materials without a translator.

Exclusion Criteria:

Non-meeting the above.
